description: The shared exit-rule vectors of circuit zkapi-v2-concession-v1, one file for every client: the companion wallet (zkapi-client tests/shared_vectors.rs, and zkapi-companion for the exit kit), the browser SDK (sdk/test/zkapi-exit-rules-vectors.test.mjs, through its pure exit policy and the shipped WebAssembly) and zkapi-clientd (the E5 payout matcher and the exit-proof lifetime) must reproduce every expected value; a change here is a change to all of them. Sections: successor_checks (S1-S6, design §6.1); concession_allowed and ownership_proof (C3, §6.3); near_expiry (C4); constants, e_low, must_initiate_by and unsettled_escape_after (E0, §6.4); classify and decide (E1-E3, with the C5/E2.4 clearance outcomes); payout (E5); lock_releasable (E6); exit_kit (E7). C1 (one lock) and C2 (one bound per state) are tested in each implementation; E4's calldata is the shared withdrawal golden vector (protocol/contracts/test/fixtures/withdrawal-golden.json). Times are UNIX seconds, amounts are billing units. `ZKAPI_WRITE_VECTORS=1 cargo test -p zkapi-client --test shared_vectors` regenerates successor_checks; every other section is hand-written from the design.

decide.name: E2 nothing released: mutual close
E2 every release resolved: mutual close
E2 within an hour of must_initiate_by: escape conceding nothing
E2 clearance refused or unreachable: escape conceding nothing
E2 nullifier_used: E3 waits from the newest release
E2 nullifier_used at T: escape conceding the bound
E2 nullifier_used with nothing released: escape at once conceding nothing
E2 nullifier_used with no record of the release: escape at once conceding the bound
E3 pending request: wait for created_at + W + 900
E3 reported settlement deadline shortens the wait
E3 at T: escape conceding the bound
E3 T is capped by the escape-after knob
E3 T is capped by must_initiate_by
E3 forced early exit concedes nothing by default
E3 forced early exit may concede the bound
E3 lost epsilon concedes the reported charge at once
E3 lost epsilon concedes at most the bound
E3 the newest unresolved release sets T
E3 an invalid successor is handled like a withheld one
E1 resolved an old unknown reading: fresh again
Terminal records do not block a mutual close
E2 a zero bound is fresh whatever the records say: mutual close
E3 lost epsilon is decided at once, also where the records call the state fresh
E2 within an hour of must_initiate_by the cutoff comes before a claimed reservation: escape conceding nothing
E2 nullifier_used waits from the newest release at the state, a terminal one too

lock_releasable.name: no exit proof released: the user cancels
no exit proof released and no cancel: held
only an ownership proof released: the user cancels
a released escape outlives a cancel
the finalized block is not past valid_until + 900
dead: the finalized block and the local clock are past valid_until + 900
the finalized block is past valid_until + 900 but the local clock is not: an RPC never releases a live proof
the same with a trusted reading: an Active release always waits for the local clock
a pending exit keeps the lock
every released proof must be dead
Closed through the exit RPC (trusted) releases a live lock
an untrusted Closed reading waits for the local clock
an untrusted Closed reading after the local clock passes
Closed with only an ownership proof released

ownership_proof.name: no ownership proof of this state was sent: make one
the state's proof is live: send it again, also under a new lock
within the resend margin, still accepted: none until it expires

successor_checks.description: S1-S6 (design §6.1) for circuit zkapi-v2-concession-v1. Load `state` and `journal` (a case's own `journal` replaces it), deliver each `response` for the journal's request, and expect `install`, `invalid_successor` (a correctly signed successor failing S3, S4 or S5, archived and treated as withheld) or `reject` (S1, S2 or S6 fails; nothing changes). For `install`, `installed` is the resulting balance, anchor, prev_anchor, blinding and bound_at_state.

cases.name: S3 the journaled request's bound is not bound_at_state: invalid_successor
charge equal to the bound: install
S4 another note's derived anchor: invalid_successor
S6 signed by another key: reject
S6 checked before S4: an unsigned non-derived anchor is rejected

exit_kit.description: E7: a zkapi-exit-kit-v1 the browser SDK sealed (buildExitKitPayload and sealExitKit, crates/zkapi-companion/tests/fixtures/make-sdk-exit-kit.mjs). Every client opens `fixture` with `passphrase`, refuses `wrong_passphrase`, and reads `expected`.
